question: Which are the two main organs in the human body where the magnetic field produced is significant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Heart and Brain.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The two human body organs where magnetism is produced significantly are the **heart and the brain.**
 
• The Magnetism present in the brain of a human is used to obtain images of internal parts of the brain by **MRI technique.**
 
• The **heart **produces the greatest rhythmic electromagnetic field in all of the body's organs.
 
• It is the most** strong source of electromagnetic energy** in the human body.
 
• **The electrical activity produced by the heart has a 60-fold greater magnitude than the electrical activity generated by the brain.**
 
• The current from the brain causes the scalp to generate an **electroencephalogram (EEG).**
 
• It also generates a magnetic field around the head, which is calculated as a **magnetoencephalogram (MEG). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The human body generates diverse electrical activity in a variety of cell types.
 
• This comprises neurons, endocrine cells, and muscle cells, many of which are referred to as** "excitable cells."**
 
• This action generates a magnetic field, as does all electricity.
 
• Magnetite was included in "almost every bit" of the specimens, according to the findings.
 
• When our bodies are no longer exposed to the gravitational field, the current ceases.
